query: I have a 95-year-old man. Among male patients aged 90–100 with sepsis, what's the standard deviation of ICU LOS (days)?
final_sql:
WITH SepsisPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    p.subject_id,
    p.gender,
    p.anchor_age,
    a.hadm_id,
    a.admittime,
    a.dischtime,
    a.deathtime,
    a.admission_type,
    a.hospital_expire_flag
  FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` AS p
  INNER JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` AS a
    ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id
  WHERE
    p.gender = 'M'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 90 AND 100
    AND a.admission_type = 'EMERGENCY'
),
SepsisDiagnosis AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s.subject_id,
    s.hadm_id
  FROM SepsisPatients AS s
  INNER JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` AS d
    ON s.subject_id = d.subject_id AND s.hadm_id = d.hadm_id
